what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Malaysia in Australia: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3139 Malaysian asylum seekers in Australia, 57.0% of all asylum seekers from Malaysia.
Refugees from Malaysia, a separate group, live mostly in Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Malaysia: over Sabah territory with the Sultanate of Sulu in 2013.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Malaysia.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 104 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 19065, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Australia.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Australia only.
